scripts.dev:api: node scripts/workspace.mjs @agent-chat/shared build && node scripts/workspace.mjs @agent-chat/api dev
scripts.dev:web: node scripts/workspace.mjs @agent-chat/shared build && node scripts/workspace.mjs @agent-chat/web dev
scripts.build: node scripts/workspace.mjs @agent-chat/shared build && node scripts/workspace.mjs @agent-chat/api build && node scripts/workspace.mjs @agent-chat/web build
